facts.text: The resort is a beach resort on Dubai's Palm 'riviera'.
facts.excerpt: At our refined beach resort on Dubai’s Palm ‘riviera’, coastal calm meets urban energy.

facts.text: The architecture is Andalusian, complemented by lush gardens.
facts.excerpt: Elegant Andalusian architecture is complemented by lush gardens and a private beach.

facts.text: The resort has a private beach.
facts.excerpt: Elegant Andalusian architecture is complemented by lush gardens and a private beach.

facts.text: The resort's secluded beach looks out on Dubai's skyline.
facts.excerpt: A stunning, secluded beach offers privileged views of Dubai’s glittering skyline.

facts.text: The resort sits on The Palm island.
facts.excerpt: Dubai's most intimate seaside resort commands a prime spot on The Palm island.

facts.text: The resort can arrange luxury transfers from Dubai International Airport, about a 45-minute drive.

facts.text: The resort can assist guests with Dubai visa applications.

facts.text: The resort is on West Crescent, Palm Jumeirah.
Rooms have an in-room Nespresso machine.
facts.excerpt: The in-room Nespresso machine, a rarity in many hotels now, is a welcome treat.

facts.text: Rooms have a Bose speaker and dock system.
facts.excerpt: The Bose speaker and dock system helps keep the room your own personal oasis.

facts.text: Bathrooms are spacious and stocked with full-size Acqua di Parma products.
facts.excerpt: So spacious, in fact, that the AdP products come in full-size, not travel-size, bottles.

facts.text: Butlers book restaurants, arrange spa visits and plan day trips for guests.
facts.excerpt: From booking restaurants and arranging spa visits to planning day trips, he'll be your vacation lifeline.

facts.text: The beach never feels crowded, and daybeds are almost always available at the pools.
facts.excerpt: The beach never feels crowded, even when the hotel is full. Same goes for the magnificent pools, where you'll almost always find a daybed waiting to be occupied.

facts.text: A palm-covered oasis surrounds the hotel, giving it a serene, protected feel.
facts.excerpt: A palm-covered oasis surrounding the hotel gives it a serene, protected vibe.

facts.text: Rooms are very quiet, day and night.
facts.excerpt: You won’t hear a soul outside your room, day or night.
